name: xDuoo
_terms_TWO_SITES_TWO_ANSWERS: Measured 2026-11-25. xDuoo runs two sites and they answer the terms question differently. xduoo.com, the Chinese primary domain, has NO terms page: /terms/, /terms-of-use/, /legal/, /privacy/, /disclaimer/ and /copyright/ all return 404, its page-sitemap.xml lists nine pages and none is legal, and its only legal text is an unlinked footer line carrying a company name and an ICP filing number. xduoo.net, the English site linked from the Chinese header as « English Website », DOES publish terms at /terms and they were read in full: the only clause touching use of the site is « Do not misuse the website, interfere with its operation or attempt unauthorized access to website or customer information », and the only clause touching specifications is « Product availability, specifications and included accessories may be updated. » Neither forbids copying or reuse. /privacy was also read and covers order data only. Footer: « (c) 2026 xDuoo. All Rights Reserved. » So every record under this brand is sourced to xduoo.net, whose terms were read and permit it; xduoo.com's question remains unasked, and nothing is sourced there.
_every_spec_on_the_Chinese_site_is_an_im: Verified on 14 pages of xduoo.com - TA-32, TA-30, XA-02, XA-10, TA-22, XD05 PRO, XD05T, MU-604, MU-601, MU-602, DT-01, MH-02, DM-01, CDM-10. Each page's whole extractable text is about 950 bytes of navigation and footer; under a « Description » heading there is nothing, while the body holds 23 to 43 images named like TA-32详情切片_01.jpg - « 详情切片 » means detail slices. No figure was read off any of them. This is the same wall as HiFi ROSE and iBasso, with one difference that saves the brand: xDuoo publishes the same products as TEXT on its English site, so the pictures cost nothing here. For the models that exist only in Chinese - TA-10R, TA-68, MT-04, MT-602, XQ-60, XQ-100, X-L01, Magic Stick, the first-generation XD05 BAL, XD05BAL-CP, BD34302 - they cost everything, and those models are absent from the base for that reason alone.
_native_DSD_is_TEMPLATE_TEXT_not_an_asse: « DSD512 support enables native high-resolution music playback », with DSD256 and DSD128 variants, appears WORD FOR WORD on more than twenty xduoo.net pages, including the R2R Card and the X2S player. It is template text generated per model, not a statement about any device's transport. So `native_dsd` is written on NO xDuoo record, although the word native appears on nearly all of them. DoP is stated on exactly one page in the whole catalogue, the LINK10, and only there is `dop` recorded. This is the first brand where a field had to be refused BECAUSE the maker asserts it everywhere: a claim made identically about twenty different products is a claim about none of them.
_the_Headphone_Output_row_also_holds_DIG: xduoo.net's spec table labels every output row « Headphone Output », digital outputs included. On DP-01 that row reads « RCA, coaxial, optical and USB digital outputs »; on MU-605 « Coaxial, optical, AUX and XLR balanced outputs »; on XQ-50 Pro2 « Coaxial, optical and AUX outputs »; on DT-01 « Optical, coaxial, USB, AUX and headphone outputs ». NONE of those is an input. The row that lists inputs is always « Input Interface ». A harvester keying on the words coaxial and optical would have given four devices digital inputs they do not have, and on DT-01 would have recorded a USB input that is a USB output.
_the_records_too_thin_to_exist: Read and deliberately not recorded, because the page states no sample rate at all and answers « Playback format information is pending confirmation »: MU-603, MU-605, XQ-50 Pro2, XQ-50 Pro3, Link2, DP-10, and the ES9039SPRO, AK4499EX and BD34301 cards whose spec tables have no rows whatsoever. Each names a converter part in prose and nothing else. A record carrying a part number and no behaviour would pass the verifier and tell a consumer's engine nothing, so the absence is recorded here rather than as eleven hollow files. Also excluded as converting to Bluetooth rather than to analogue: MX-02, MX-C1, Uplink.
